title: Individual self-immolation at Sukhbaatar Square amid an award-recipient gathering
reason: The opened report describes one individual’s act and does not establish a collective public assembly making a demand to Mongolia’s government. People nearby were reported to be congratulating state-award recipients; their crowd is not linked to the individual or identified as a protest.
notes: The report says the motive remained under investigation. An unofficial unpaid-wages allegation is explicitly unconfirmed and does not establish a protest demand. The surrounding crowd’s size and any protest participation are unknown.
